scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof plus independently run standard-library finite certificates; no claim of independent expert or machine-checked proof, no published authorship claimed.
scientific_limitations: The fifteen profiles are abstract Frobenius/Weyl possibilities; realization for each small field is not asserted. Historical graph and split-case results are prior work. The general formula is for smooth quartic del Pezzo surfaces in odd characteristic and the complement of all sixteen geometric (-1)-curves. Full priority against every older disguised incidence table remains a literature risk.
title: Frobenius zeta formula and fifteen incidence profiles for the sixteen-line complement of a quartic del Pezzo surface
